Downtown Historic Core.name: Downtown Historic Core
Downtown Historic Core.description: Dr. A.J. Chandler park and the ostrich-farm heritage grid around San Marcos and Arizona Avenue, with adaptive reuse, murals-and-patios retail, and steady downtown infill permitting.

Andersen Springs & Chandler Blvd.name: Andersen Springs & Chandler Blvd
Andersen Springs & Chandler Blvd.description: Office-park and apartment belt along the Chandler Boulevard frontage with build-to-rent infill, valley-metro commuter demand, and steady TI/tenant-improvement permitting.

Intel Ocotillo Tech Belt.name: Intel Ocotillo Tech Belt
Intel Ocotillo Tech Belt.description: Price Road Corridor employment core anchored by the Intel Ocotillo campus and supplier vendors, with the metro's highest-valuation commercial trades and engineering-led permit velocity.

Marlborough Park Estates.name: Marlborough Park Estates
Marlborough Park Estates.description: North Chandler residential belt around the MARLBOROUGH ESTATES plat (recorded 1973) with pool/deck auxiliary permits, roof-replacement cadence, and Kyrene-school family churn.

West Chandler Kyrene Belt.name: West Chandler Kyrene Belt
West Chandler Kyrene Belt.description: Western edge toward the Kyrene corridor with 1970s-80s tract stock, renovation-led permitting, and the I-10/Pecos logistics commute shed.

Chandler Municipal Airport.name: Chandler Municipal Airport
Chandler Municipal Airport.description: Reliever-airport industrial district with hangar and flight-school tenancy, airpark-adjacent light industrial trades, and the East Valley logistics gateway.

Ocotillo Lakes.name: Ocotillo Lakes
Ocotillo Lakes.description: Lake-amenity master plan of 58 recorded Ocotillo plats with golf-front custom stock, waterfront renovation, and the city's steadiest high-valuation residential trades.

Fulton Ranch.name: Fulton Ranch
Fulton Ranch.description: Master-planned village on the Gila River canal system with estate lots, village-retail pads, and continued build-out permitting at the metro's southwest edge.

Sun Groves.name: Sun Groves
Sun Groves.description: Southeast-corner subdivision family of twelve recorded parcels with newer-roof stock, Chandler Heights corridor retail pads, and the metro's fastest family-formation churn.

Springfield, Cooper Commons & Circle G.name: Springfield, Cooper Commons & Circle G
Springfield, Cooper Commons & Circle G.description: Southeast master-planned belt of the SPRINGFIELD, COOPER COMMONS and CIRCLE G AT RIGGS HOMESTEAD RANCH plats with elementary-school build-out, horse-property transition lots, and pool/ patio auxiliary permitting.
